test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: A trader bought 640 kg of rice. He sold a part of the rice at 20% profit and the rest at 5% loss. He earned a profit of 15% in the entire transaction. What is the ratio of the quantity of rice that he sold at a loss of 5% to that of the quantity that he sold at a profit of 20%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the rule of Alligation on the profit/loss percentages.

Profit part = +20%, Loss part = −5%, Overall Profit = +15%.

Ratio (Profit : Loss) = (15 − (−5)) : (20 − 15) = 20 : 5 = 4 : 1.

Required ratio (Loss : Profit) = 1 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total quantity of rice = 640 kg

Profit on Part 1 = 20%

Loss on Part 2 = 5% (represented as −5% profit)

Overall transaction profit = 15%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0127b803ba340075204e14d1246ef71473a196eb88a9434a0e2c1df1962c10c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let quantity sold at 20% profit be Q₁ and quantity sold at 5% loss be Q₂.

⇒ By Alligation rule: Q₁ / Q₂ = (Mean Value − Lower Value) / (Higher Value − Mean Value)

⇒ Q₁ / Q₂ = (15 − (−5)) / (20 − 15)

⇒ Q₁ / Q₂ = 20 / 5

⇒ Q₁ / Q₂ = 4 / 1

⇒ The ratio of Profit Quantity to Loss Quantity = 4 : 1

⇒ The ratio of Loss Quantity to Profit Quantity = 1 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rule of Alligation

It is used to find the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices/percentages are mixed to produce a mixture of a known average price/percentage. Ratio = (Cheaper / Difference) : (Dearer / Difference).

Profit and Loss signs

While using alligation for profit and loss, always treat profit as a positive value and loss as a negative value (e.g., 5% loss = −5% profit).

Total Quantity calculation

If the total quantity is known, individual quantities can be found by: Quantity = (Individual Ratio / Total Ratio) × Total Quantity.
